text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy's running displays the<n>extent of her
future potential. Full of<n>confidence, she expects a
rush of<n>reporters to arrive eager to interview<n>her,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She garners little attention, with only a<n>few lines of
mention published in a<n>general magazine.
Frustrated, she<n>vows to enter a bigger race.
However, something seems amiss<n>with her legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's legs can be fickle<n>when they
first become race-ready.<n>Burdening them
excessively could<n>cause inflammation and prevent
Shinko Windy from running well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, she should avoid overuse<n>and work on
adjusting her body to<n>the rigors of racing. In the
meantime,<n>we decide to build up her fan base.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her popularity rises, the media<n>coverage on her
is sure to increase in<n>turn. This renews her
motivation to<n>press forward!
